feature: question-alert Claude Code mod installed on setup
description: hexa embeds its Claude Code mods as a local marketplace, decides idempotent install steps in the domain, runs them through the ClaudePlugins port, and installs them during bootstrap and dev init without ever failing setup because of them.

specs.description: The embedded marketplace is named hexa and lists question-alert by relative source
specs.given: the embedded asset folder hexa-cli/assets/claude-mods/
specs.then: its name is "hexa" and its plugins include an entry named "question-alert" with "source": "./question-alert"

specs.description: The question-alert plugin folder is a complete Claude Code plugin
specs.given: the embedded asset folder hexa-cli/assets/claude-mods/
specs.then: it contains .claude-plugin/plugin.json and hooks/hooks.json, and plugin.json names the plugin "question-alert"

specs.description: No marketplace entry points outside the marketplace folder or at a missing folder
specs.given: the embedded .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
specs.when: every plugin entry's source is checked
specs.then: each source has the form "./<mod>", where <mod> is the entry's name and a folder of that name exists beside .claude-plugin/. No source is absolute, remote, or points to a folder that does not exist.

specs.description: Claude unavailable yields exactly one Skip naming claude
specs.given: available = false, installed = [], marketplace = /home/u/.hexa/claude-mods, mods = ["question-alert"]
specs.then: the result is exactly one Step::Skip(reason), and reason contains "claude"

specs.description: Nothing installed yields AddMarketplace then Install
specs.given: available = true, installed = [], marketplace = /m, mods = ["question-alert"]
specs.then: the result is [AddMarketplace(/m), Install("question-alert@hexa")]

specs.description: Everything already installed yields no steps
specs.given: available = true, installed = ["question-alert@hexa", "other@elsewhere"], marketplace = /m, mods = ["question-alert"]
specs.then: the result is empty

specs.description: Only missing mods are installed, in the order of mods
specs.given: available = true, installed = ["b@hexa"], marketplace = /m, mods = ["c", "b", "a"]
specs.then: the result is [AddMarketplace(/m), Install("c@hexa"), Install("a@hexa")]

specs.description: A mod installed from another marketplace does not count as installed
specs.given: available = true, installed = ["question-alert@other", "question-alert"], marketplace = /m, mods = ["question-alert"]
specs.then: the result is [AddMarketplace(/m), Install("question-alert@hexa")]. It is not empty.

specs.description: Unavailable claude never yields AddMarketplace or Install, even when mods are missing or already installed
specs.given: available = false, with installed = [] or installed = ["question-alert@hexa"], marketplace = /m, mods = ["question-alert"]
specs.then: in both cases the result is exactly one Skip, with no AddMarketplace and no Install step

specs.description: Shape of the steps for every input
specs.given: any available, any installed list, any marketplace path, any mods list
specs.then: if available is false, the result is exactly [Skip(r)] with r containing "claude". Otherwise, let missing be the mods m, in mods order, for which "m@hexa" is not in installed. If missing is empty, the result is empty. If it is not, the result is [AddMarketplace(marketplace)] followed by Install("m@hexa") for each m in missing, in order.

specs.description: Idempotence: running the steps once leaves nothing to do
specs.given: available = true, any installed list, any marketplace, any mods
specs.when: install_steps is called, the ids of its Install steps are added to installed, and install_steps is called again with the same marketplace and mods
specs.then: the second result is empty

specs.description: apply runs the steps through the port and reports each outcome
specs.given: a fake ClaudePlugins with available = true, installed = Ok([]), and add_marketplace and install succeeding
specs.then: the fake receives add_marketplace(/m) and then install("question-alert@hexa"). The result is [(AddMarketplace(/m), Ok(())), (Install("question-alert@hexa"), Ok(()))].

specs.description: Nothing to do means no port mutations
specs.given: a fake ClaudePlugins with available = true and installed = Ok(["question-alert@hexa"])
specs.then: the result is empty, and add_marketplace and install are never called

specs.description: A failed step does not stop the later steps
specs.given: a fake ClaudePlugins with available = true and installed = Ok([]), where add_marketplace returns Err("boom") and install("a@hexa") returns Err("nope")
specs.then: install is still called for "a@hexa" and for "b@hexa". The result is [(AddMarketplace(/m), Err("boom")), (Install("a@hexa"), Err("nope")), (Install("b@hexa"), Ok(()))].

specs.description: A failing installed() is treated as nothing installed, not as a fatal error
specs.given: a fake ClaudePlugins with available = true, installed() returning Err("cli broke"), and add_marketplace and install succeeding
specs.then: apply does not panic. The result is [(AddMarketplace(/m), Ok(())), (Install("question-alert@hexa"), Ok(()))].

specs.description: Unavailable claude: the Skip is reported and nothing is attempted
specs.given: a fake ClaudePlugins with available = false
specs.then: the result has exactly one entry, whose step is Skip(reason) with reason containing "claude". add_marketplace and install are never called.

specs.description: apply reports exactly install_steps' steps, each run once, and never panics
specs.given: any fake ClaudePlugins (any available, installed() returning Ok(any list) or Err, and add_marketplace and install each returning any mix of Ok and Err), any marketplace, any mods
specs.then: it returns without panicking. The steps in the result, in order, equal install_steps(available, installed-or-empty-on-Err, marketplace, mods). Each AddMarketplace step corresponds to exactly one add_marketplace call and each Install(id) step to exactly one install(id) call. Each reported outcome is the outcome the port returned for that call.

specs.description: hexa bootstrap extracts the mods and installs question-alert
specs.given: a machine where claude is available and question-alert@hexa is not installed
specs.then: ~/.hexa/claude-mods/ contains .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and question-alert/. apply is called with that folder and ["question-alert"]. One line is printed per step (add marketplace, install question-alert@hexa). The command exits 0.

specs.description: hexa dev init does the same extraction and install
specs.given: a project directory and a machine where claude is available
specs.then: ~/.hexa/claude-mods/ is extracted, apply is called with that folder and ["question-alert"], and one line is printed per step

specs.description: Extraction overwrites stale files hexa owns
specs.given: ~/.hexa/claude-mods/question-alert/hooks/hooks.json exists with content that differs from the embedded asset
specs.when: hexa bootstrap or hexa dev init runs
specs.then: that file's content equals the embedded asset afterwards

specs.description: Missing claude produces a warning and does not fail setup
specs.given: a machine where the claude binary cannot be run
specs.when: hexa bootstrap or hexa dev init runs
specs.then: a warning line naming claude is printed for the Skip step, and the command's exit status is the same as it would be with claude present

specs.description: A failed install produces a warning and does not fail setup
specs.given: a machine where claude is available but claude plugin install fails
specs.when: hexa bootstrap or hexa dev init runs
specs.then: the failed step is printed as a warning carrying the error, and the command does not exit non-zero because of it
